Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 28 percent and disapproval at 63 percent.

Independents also remain firmly negative, with 29 percent approving and 62 percent disapproving. Women disapprove by a 64-to-30 margin, while men are somewhat more divided at 52 percent disapprove to 41 percent approve. results.content: An average of national polls has 38.6 percent of Americans giving Trump a thumbs up today, a 0.4-point increase from where he stood on August 3. In comparison, 57.7 percent give him a thumbs down, a drop of 1.1 points from last month’s number. Trump’s net approval rating now stands at -19.1 points. His lowest number so far this year was the -20.6 points he recorded last month.
